thesis: Exceptional Q3 (record-high stock, favorable purchasing conditions) with +26% gap on 3.3x volume, closed at 0.97 of range while SPY fell 4.4% that day. Information-backed up-moves tend to drift as estimates rise; relative strength in a crash.
